title: Plural genitive before a noun
focus: Use a plural genitive for several owners or related things: lasten kirja (“the children's book”).

exercises.prompt: Complete “The children's toy.” ____ lelu. Use lapsi (plural).
exercises.explanation: Use lasten for more than one lapsi. The number of the following noun is independent. Also accepted here: lapsien.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: Use a plural genitive for several owners or related things: lasten kirja (“the children's book”).
